headline: THE AI TABOO
JUST DIED AT
STAGE 21
scenes.lede: Three-quarters into 2026, AI stopped being Hollywood’s unmentionable — and started showing up as a line item.

headline: STAGE 21,
MANHATTAN
BEACH
items: Same lot as the “volume” screens where Jon Favreau shot The Mandalorian.
Lightstorm Entertainment — James Cameron’s Na’vi shop — sits alongside it.
Stage 21 now houses Innovative Dreams, an AI offshoot of Jon Erwin’s Wonder Project.
COO Bryan Yee is the one walking journalists through the LED screens.

headline: BITCOIN: $200M
DOWN TO $70M
items: Doug Liman’s “Bitcoin”, produced by Ryan Kavanaugh’s Acme Studios.
Kavanaugh credits AI with the cut — and says so out loud.
scenes.stat_caption: Below-the-line on the same film, before and after.

headline: THE QUIET
PART IS OVER
items: Scorsese: filmmakers have to be “open to how [film] can evolve”.
Lucas, in July: “There’s nothing you can do about it.”
Tribeca premiered the AI docudrama “Dreams of Violets”.

headline: WATCH THE
DISCLOSURE
FIGHT
items: Kathleen Kennedy helped convene an industry group to agree how Hollywood talks about AI.
Pew and Gallup both show public fear rising, not falling.
Below-the-line is where the savings land — and where crews feel it first.
Erwin’s read: it “heightens your creativity and did not diminish it at all”.

BEFORE YOU
SHOOT IT
